g.text: totalCents is a stored snapshot of Σ lineTotalCents()
readyAt and expiresAt are computed from the store's opening
hours when the order is created and stored (BR-12).
Overdue AWAITING_PICKUP orders become EXPIRED and their
units return to stock exactly once (BR-20).
Payment happens at the store and is not recorded (BR-09).
Stock is decremented when the order is created (BR-11).
unitPriceCents = product price at the time
